body:
People - OCTOBER 23, 2026

Alex Leung has joined KKR as head of infrastructure thought leadership.

Previously, Leung spent eight years at UBS Asset Management, where he was the head of infrastructure research and strategy and a member of the investment committee. Before that, he was a vice president at Sanford C. Bernstein, a sell-side equity research firm, where he covered the global energy, industrials and commodities sectors.

“I am looking forward to this next chapter of my career and working with an incredible team,” Leung wrote in a LinkedIn posting. “I’m also grateful for eight great years at UBS and for the many colleagues who made that chapter so meaningful.”

p: Alex Leung이 인프라 스로트 리더십(thought leadership) 헤드로 KKR에 합류했다.
이에 앞서 Leung은 UBS Asset Management에서 8년간 재직하며 인프라 리서치 및 전략 헤드이자 투자위원회 위원을 역임했다. 그전에는 매도 사이드 주식 리서치 회사인 Sanford C. Bernstein에서 부사장을 지내며 글로벌 에너지, 산업재 및 원자재 섹터를 커버했다.
Leung은 LinkedIn 게시글을 통해 "내 커리어의 다음 장을 열며 훌륭한 팀과 함께하게 되어 기대된다"며, "또한 UBS에서의 멋진 8년과 그 시기를 의미 있게 만들어준 많은 동료들에게 감사하다"고 밝혔다.
